title: Sidney Bechet could not read music
summary: Bechet, as great as he was, could not read music; Bigard did not know him in New Orleans but met him later in New York.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Sidney Bechet: the man, the horn, the legend

blocks.x: Albert Nicholas and a couple of other guys. You see, as big as Sidney Bechet was, he couldn't read a note big as this whole house, and, like, he could play --
No, the guy he could play though. Fantastic.
Did you ever know Sidney Bechet in New Orleans?
Sure. Oh, sure. Not in New Orleans.
Later. I met him in Chicago -- New York. I met him in New York first. And he's fantastic, He's great.
But that's a bit that a lot of people when they write they don't know what they're writing about, you know.
